This is a nice small place that a friend brought me to last night. I saw the other reviews and was quite skeptical. However it IS bar food and is located in an area where you typically get charged more.If you want fancy food this isn't the place but if you want to eat something because you're drunk it's a great place to go. Service was stellar, bartender whipped up some drinks for a friend and me and she DID NOT skimp on the alcohol. Boudin Balls: Delicious! Completely full off of this. Huge boudin balls with a kick, could have eaten as main course. Seriously craving these right now. Crawfish Pies: Empanada style crust, stuffed with crawfish. Also delicious! Ate dinner here one night. Very low key, we walked right in and bellied up to the bar. Not much beer on tap, but that's okay because other than Bud, Abita is the beer of choice and it's a light enough amber/brown beer to hold up to the NOLA heat. I ate the boudin po'boy. Totally huge, but very tasty. I could only eat half of it, but it was a very flavorful half. The boudin was nicely seasoned with a little kick of spice. The french fries were heavily seasoned as well. My husband ordered the soft shell crab sandwich served on ciabatta bread and came with a romaine/red onion/roma tomato side salad.
